name: color-picker
summary: A colour picker (color-picker.vue) — a 20×20 swatch preview + chevron trigger opening an MPopover with a colour canvas (vue-color Sketch) + a 16-colour preset palette. Supports `transparent` (a swatch with a red diagonal line). Used for branding, widget, threshold and severity colour selection.

states.name: transparent
states.what: swatch shows a red diagonal line

decisionFlow: Picking a COLOUR (branding, widget series, threshold)? -> Color Picker.
A fixed SEVERITY colour? -> use the --severity-* token, not a free picker.
Not a colour (any other value)? -> a Dropdown / Select / Input, not this.
do: Use for free colour choice: brand/theme, widget series, threshold/gauge bands, dashboard background.
Offer the 16-colour preset palette for quick on-brand picks; allow a custom hex via the canvas.
Support transparent where no-fill is valid (renders a red diagonal swatch).
dont: Do not use for fixed severity/status colours — those come from --severity-* tokens for consistency.
Do not use for non-colour values (use a Dropdown/Select/Input).
Do not rely on colour alone to convey meaning — pair with a label/icon (a11y).

value.note: the selected colour (hex or 'transparent'); reflects to el.value on every pick

presets.note: override the 16-colour preset palette (JSON string / array / comma list)

allow-transparent.note: offer a no-fill (transparent) option — renders a swatch with a red diagonal line

hide-arrow.note: hide the chevron next to the swatch

events: change — { detail: colour (hex or 'transparent') } (array-wrapped, unwrap detail[0])

color-picker.useWhen: the user picks a COLOUR — a swatch trigger that opens a canvas + the 16-colour preset palette
color-picker.dontUse: for non-colour values (use a Dropdown/Select). For a fixed severity colour, prefer the severity token, not a free picker.
color-picker.example: branding logo/theme colour, widget series colour, threshold/severity colour, dashboard background. Supports transparent.

a11y.summary: The trigger is a clickable swatch; the palette cells should have accessible names (the hex/colour name) and keyboard focus. Ensure the current value is announced.

changelog: 2026-08-06 — Hardening: stop the internal native <input> `input` event from leaking out of the shadow DOM (@input.stop) so a stray composed native `input` (e.detail=0) can no longer reach consumer listeners on the host. Same class of fix as obs-input.

2026-07-11: shipped the real <obs-color-picker> web component — a 20×20 swatch + chevron trigger opening a top-layer popover with the 16-colour preset palette, a custom-colour canvas (native colour input; product uses vue-color Sketch) and a hex readout; supports `transparent` (red diagonal swatch) via allow-transparent. Reflects el.value + emits `change` on every pick. Top-layer Popover so it's correct inside animated ancestors.
2026-07-11: catalogued (Group C) — Storybook story with the swatch trigger + the real 16-colour preset palette + hex readout + transparent state.
